# Groove at Home

> Groove at Home is a live funk, nu-jazz, and soul collective based in Italy, available for booking at festivals, club nights, private events, and collaborations across Italy and Europe.

Founded in 2023 by Francesco Coppola Bove and co-founder Gianmaria Salerno, starting in a home studio with no label and no plan. Today it is an open collective of 120+ musicians from across Italy and beyond, rather than a fixed lineup — singers, keyboardists, bassists, guitarists, saxophonists, trumpeters, and drummers who rotate in depending on the project and the stage.

"Grab a Chair", the band's album of covers, came out on November 6, 2026. On November 8, 2026 the band released its first original single, "Dove Nessuno Guarda", and "Leave a Message", a Pino Daniele cover made for the Musicante Awards – Premio Pino Daniele 2026. At the final, Groove at Home performed "Leave a Message" with Cuban pianist Gonzalo Rubalcaba and received a plaque citing them for Arrangements, Reworking of Pino Daniele's music, Research & Contamination, and Ensemble. The first album of original material is planned for 2027; several tracks are already road-tested live.

## Facts

- Genres: Funk, Nu-Jazz, Soul, R&B, Jazz Fusion
- Founded: 2023, in a home studio, Italy
- Founders: Francesco Coppola Bove, co-founder Gianmaria Salerno
- Collective size: 120+ musicians (47 singers, 23 keyboardists, 20 bassists, 17 guitarists, 11 saxophonists, 7 trumpeters, 2 drummers)
- Live set: 70–90 minutes, band format of 6 musicians (expandable to 8)
- Touring: Italy & EU, worldwide on request
- Audience: 40,000+ Instagram followers, 5.75% engagement rate, 635K monthly cross-platform reach, one video at 500K views
- Official brand partner: Thomann (music retailer)
- Award: Musicante Awards – Premio Pino Daniele 2026 (Fondazione Pino Daniele), plaque citing Arrangiamenti, Elaborazione dell'opera di Pino Daniele, Ricerca e Contaminazione, Ensemble
- Notable recognition: Jacob Collier publicly commented on one of the band's arrangements
- Collaborators: Gonzalo Rubalcaba (live, Musicante Awards 2026), Mario Biondi, Francesca Tandoi (studio); also Arabella Rustico, Gabriele Esposito and others
- Selected live history: Nocera Jazz Festival (2025), Kroton Jazz Festival, BIKO (Milan), Crazy Coqs (London), Das Wohnzimmer (Wiesbaden) — all sold out
- Latest releases: "Grab a Chair" (covers album, November 6, 2026) — https://open.spotify.com/album/62ElELhu952OgTmap8r4e3 ; "Dove Nessuno Guarda" (first original single, November 8, 2026) — https://open.spotify.com/track/4UE9XRR1wMkd9RfAT0IYoi ; "Leave a Message" (Pino Daniele cover, November 8, 2026) — https://open.spotify.com/track/0boushE9rMIQhKfPO75Gir
- Contact for booking: athomegroove@gmail.com
